component.name: BearWave
component.summary: Desktop internet radio app for Linux

description.p: BearWave is a Qt 6 desktop internet radio player for fast station browsing, simple playback controls, favorites, resume support, and tray behavior without turning into a heavy media suite. It targets Linux desktops in general and integrates via standard Wayland, MPRIS, and the system tray.

ul.li: Internet radio via the Radio Browser API with local JSON caching
Station pages for Top, Germany, Netherlands, and an interactive World view
Local search and filtering by name, genre, and country
Sorting by name, bitrate, and votes
Favorites and My stations (manual streams) with local persistence
Now Playing stage with artwork, track metadata, and session track history
Responsive transport: stage dock, compact bottom strip, or full player bar
System light/dark theme and visible connection states
Resume support for last station and volume
MPRIS integration for desktop media controls and media keys
System tray integration for background playback
Desktop notifications for song/track changes with local cover art caching
German, Dutch, and Russian translations with localized country names
Validated station artwork with official-homepage discovery

screenshot.caption: Main window with station list, details, and player controls
World browser with localized country names
About dialog with language selection and release notes

Added validated station artwork, homepage icon discovery, safe fallbacks, and bounded cache cleanup
Added visible connection and retry states plus safer metadata and cover handling
Added an in-app changelog and a consistent BearWave button style
Security: enforce http/https stream URLs on every playback and persisted-state path
Use the SVG app and tray icon while retaining the PNG fallback
Fix light borders on search and dialog buttons in the dark theme
Fix Flatpak deployment on hosts that reject permission attributes
Desktop redesign with sidebar navigation, station details, and a compact player bar
Embedded About page with full GPLv3 license text

Refreshed the dark theme and responsive search, filter, and player layouts
